The Year Beast Has Come
Compiled and Illustrated by Happy Childhood

summary_zh: 本页为绘本《年兽来了》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息和出版社信息，插图描绘了年兽出现，人们和孩童惊慌逃跑的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh: 从前，海里有一只怪兽，它的头上长着角，还有着尖利的牙齿。怪兽喜欢睡觉，每次都会睡上一年，在除夕晚上才醒来并爬上岸，于是人们称之为“年兽”。
page_text_en: Long ago, there was a monster in the sea. It had horns on its head and sharp teeth. The monster liked to sleep, and would sleep for a whole year, waking up and crawling ashore only on New Year's Eve. Thus, people called it the 'Nian beast'.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了年兽的来历：它是一只生活在海里的怪兽，头上有角、有尖牙，每年除夕才醒来上岸，因此被称为‘年兽’。插图展示了年兽闭眼睡觉的特写。

page_text_ocr_zh:
年兽一爬上岸就冲进村子找吃的。它会吃掉人们养的猪啊、牛啊，
有时候还会吃人，真是太可怕了！
page_text_en:
When the Year Beast climbs ashore, it rushes into the village looking for food. It eats the pigs and cows people raise, 
and sometimes even eats people. It's really terrifying!
summary_zh: 年兽爬上岸后冲进村子，吃掉牲畜甚至人，村民们惊慌逃跑，画面展现了年兽的凶猛和人们的恐惧。

page_text_ocr_zh: 一些年轻人用竹子削成最锋利的竹刀，还做了力道强劲的弓箭，准备杀死年兽。但是，年兽刀枪不入，再锋利的竹刀也伤不了它。所以每年除夕，它还是会出来吃掉很多牲畜和人。
page_text_en: Some young people sharpened bamboo into the sharpest knives and made powerful bows and arrows, preparing to kill the Year Beast. But the Year Beast was impervious to blades and spears; even the sharpest bamboo knives couldn't hurt it. So every New Year's Eve, it would still come out to eat many livestock and people.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了年轻人用竹刀和弓箭攻击年兽的场景，但年兽刀枪不入，武器无法伤及它，因此每年除夕它仍会出来吃掉牲畜和人。

page_text_ocr_zh:
人们都害怕了，每到除夕
这天，村里的男女老少都会逃
进深山，躲避年兽的伤害。

又一年除夕到来，寒冷的北风“呼呼”地吹着，雪花漫天飞舞着，天气冷极了，村民忙着准备上山吃的食物。
page_text_en:
Everyone was afraid. Every New Year's Eve,
the men, women, and children in the village would flee
into the deep mountains to escape the harm of the Year Beast.

Another New Year's Eve arrived. The cold northern wind blew "whoosh whoosh," snowflakes danced in the sky, the weather was extremely cold, and the villagers were busy preparing food to take up the mountain.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了除夕将至，村民们因害怕年兽而准备逃进深山，并忙着准备上山的食物，画面展现了雪夜村庄和村民搬运食物的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
村长一边大喊着：“年兽要来啦，大家快走啊！”一边带领着全村人去山上避难。
这时，从村口来了一位乞讨的老爷爷。老爷爷肩膀上挂着一个布口袋，身上穿着破旧的衣服，头发上满是雪花。
page_text_en:
The village chief shouted, "The Year Beast is coming, everyone, hurry up!" as he led everyone to the mountains to take refuge.
At this moment, an old man begging came from the village entrance. The old man had a cloth bag slung over his shoulder, wore worn-out clothes, and had snowflakes all over his hair.
summary_zh: 村长带领村民逃离年兽，途中遇到一位衣衫褴褛、满头雪花的乞讨老爷爷。

page_text_ocr_zh:
乡亲们都忙着收拾行装，这时还有
谁会留意这位需要关心的老爷爷呢？
page_text_en: The villagers were busy packing their belongings. Who would pay attention to this old man in need at such a time?
summary_zh: 在雪夜中，村民们忙着收拾行装准备逃离年兽，画面中一位衣衫褴褛的老爷爷站在雪地里，手持拐杖和饭碗，显得孤独无助，而一个小孩蹲在旁边，似乎在思考是否要帮助他。

page_text_ocr_zh: 村口的一位好心的老婆婆给了老爷爷一个馒头，说：“我的粮食也不多了，吃完了我们一起去山上躲躲年兽吧！”老爷爷说：“谢谢你，我可以帮你们把年兽给赶走。”
page_text_en: An elderly woman at the village entrance gave the old man a steamed bun and said, "My food is running out too. After you finish it, let's go up the mountain together to hide from the Year Beast!" The old man replied, "Thank you. I can help you drive the Year Beast away."
summary_zh: 在雪夜中，一位好心的老婆婆给了乞讨的老爷爷一个馒头，并邀请他一起上山躲避年兽，老爷爷表示自己可以帮助村民赶走年兽。

page_text_ocr_zh:
老婆婆很奇怪，问道：‘你不怕被年兽吃掉吗？’老爷爷说：‘我不怕年兽。’
老婆婆又劝说了一会儿，老爷爷坚持要对付年兽。老婆婆没办法，只好撇下他，跟大伙一起上山避难去了。
page_text_en:
The old woman was very puzzled and asked, 'Aren't you afraid of being eaten by the Year Beast?' The old man replied, 'I'm not afraid of the Year Beast.'

The old woman tried to persuade him for a while, but the old man insisted on facing the Year Beast. The old woman had no choice but to leave him behind and go up the mountain with everyone else to take refuge.
summary_zh: 在雪夜中，一位老婆婆劝说一位声称不怕年兽的老爷爷一起上山避难，但老爷爷坚持要对付年兽，老婆婆无奈只好独自离开。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这位老爷爷留在了老婆婆家里。只见他找来红纸、蜡烛、竹子……不知道他要干些什么。
半夜的时候，年兽闯进村子。很快，它发现村东头老婆婆家的大门上贴着红纸，屋里点着蜡烛。
page_text_en:
The old man stayed at the old woman's house. He was seen gathering red paper, candles, bamboo... no one knew what he was going to do.
In the middle of the night, the Year Beast burst into the village. Soon, it noticed that the door of the old woman's house at the east end of the village was covered with red paper, and candles were lit inside.
summary_zh: 老爷爷留在老婆婆家准备红纸、蜡烛和竹子，而年兽在半夜闯入村子，发现老婆婆家门上贴着红纸、屋里点着蜡烛。

page_text_ocr_zh:
年兽抖了几抖，它朝老婆婆
家看了看，又怪叫了一声，随后
猛扑过去。

快到门口时，院内突然传来“砰砰啪啪”的几声炸响，
吓得年兽立刻停住了脚步。
page_text_en:
The Year Beast shivered a few times. It looked toward Grandma's house, let out a strange cry, and then lunged forward.

As it neared the doorway, sudden "bang bang pop pop" explosions came from the courtyard, scaring the Year Beast and making it stop instantly.
summary_zh: 年兽在雪夜中冲向老婆婆家，但快到门口时，院内突然响起爆炸声，吓得它立刻停住了脚步。

page_text_ocr_zh:
年兽一看，吓得转身就逃，一直逃到大海边，跳进海里，再也不敢出来了。
这时，老婆婆家的门打开了，只见那位老爷爷站在门口哈哈大笑。
page_text_en:
The Year Beast looked and, frightened, turned and fled, running all the way to the seaside, jumping into the sea, and never daring to come out again.
At this moment, the door of the old woman's house opened, and there stood the old man, laughing heartily.
summary_zh: 年兽被吓跑后跳入海中，再也不敢出来；与此同时，老婆婆家的门打开，老爷爷站在门口大笑。

page_text_ocr_zh: 第二天是正月初一，避难的人们回到村里一看，只见村里安然无恙，那些之前没来得及牵走的羊也在圈子里安静地站着。这到底是怎么一回事呢？
page_text_en: The next day was the first day of the first lunar month. The people who had fled returned to the village and found it safe and sound. The sheep that hadn't been taken away earlier were quietly standing in their pen. What on earth had happened?
summary_zh: 正月初一，村民们回到村庄，发现村庄安然无恙，羊群也完好无损，对发生的事情感到疑惑。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，老婆婆才明白过来，赶忙向乡亲们说了那位老爷爷。
乡亲们来到老婆婆家，只见门上贴着红纸，院里一堆未燃尽的竹子还在“啪啪”炸响，屋内几根蜡烛还点着……
page_text_en:
At this moment, the old woman finally understood and hurriedly told the villagers about the old man.
The villagers arrived at the old woman's house and saw red paper pasted on the door, a pile of unburnt bamboo sticks still crackling "pop pop" in the yard, and several candles still burning inside the house...
summary_zh: 村民们回到老婆婆家，发现门上贴着红纸，院中竹子仍在炸响，屋内蜡烛未灭，老婆婆向他们讲述了老爷爷的事迹。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，老爷爷又出现了，他说：“年兽最怕红色、火光和炸响，你们以后可以用这些东西驱赶它。”
老爷爷说完就不见了，原来他是来驱赶年兽的神仙。人们开心极了，对着天上拜了几拜。
page_text_en:
At this moment, the old man appeared again. He said, "The Year Beast fears red, firelight, and loud noises. You can use these things to drive it away." 
The old man disappeared after speaking. He was actually a deity sent to drive away the Year Beast. The people were overjoyed and bowed to the sky several times.
summary_zh: 老爷爷现身告诉人们年兽怕红色、火光和炸响，随后消失，人们得知他是神仙，便向天空拜谢。

page_text_ocr_zh: 乡亲们为庆贺年兽被赶走，纷纷穿上新衣服、戴上新帽，到亲友家道喜。这件事很快在周围村里传开了，人们都知道了驱赶年兽的办法。
page_text_en: The villagers, celebrating the defeat of the Year Beast, put on new clothes and hats, and went to visit their relatives and friends to offer congratulations. This news quickly spread to surrounding villages, and everyone learned the method to drive away the Year Beast.
summary_zh: 乡亲们庆祝年兽被赶走，穿上新衣、戴上新帽互相拜年，驱赶年兽的方法也传开了。

page_text_ocr_zh: 从此每年除夕前，家家户户都会在门口贴上红对联、红窗花、红福字，除夕夜还会燃起爆竹、烟花，通宵点灯。初一一大早，人们还要走亲串友，互相道喜问好呢！
page_text_en: From then on, every year before New Year's Eve, every household would paste red couplets, red window decorations, and red 'Fu' characters at their doorways. On New Year's Eve, they would set off firecrackers and fireworks, and keep the lights on all night. On the first day of the New Year, people would visit relatives and friends, greeting each other with joy and good wishes!
summary_zh: 本页讲述了自老爷爷赶走年兽后，人们每年除夕前贴红对联、窗花、福字，除夕夜燃放爆竹烟花、通宵点灯，正月初一走亲访友、互相拜年的传统习俗。
